title: Exterior courtyard with multi-storey buildings, bridge and logo overlay
objects_and_counts: No people are visible in the photographed scene.
Three cylindrical rooftop tanks are visible on the roof of the left-mid building (upper left region of image).
A raised pedestrian bridge/skywalk spans between the central buildings, visible in the upper-central area.
Three clear spherical globe fixtures are visible mounted on vertical posts in the right-central foreground; each globe is individually visible and not fully obscured.
One large red-leaved bush is visible in the center foreground, partially blocking the view down the courtyard.
One conifer-like (evergreen) tree is visible behind and slightly to the right of the red bush, in the middle distance.
A low strip of grassy or reed-like planting is visible in the immediate foreground along the bottom edge of the image.
Multi-storey building façades with repeated balcony/terrace elements are visible on both left and right sides of the courtyard (left façade and right façade visible).
Two graphic/logo elements are present as overlays or printed on the image in the lower-right corner: a shield/crest and a rectangular word-mark 'BusIMan'.

The large red-leaved bush occupies the center foreground, positioned between the camera and the multi-storey buildings; it partially blocks the central sightline into the courtyard.
The pedestrian bridge/skywalk crosses from the left building to the right building above the courtyard, with its lowest point roughly centered in the upper half of the image.
The three spherical globe light fixtures are mounted on vertical posts standing in the right-central foreground, in front of the right-hand building façade.
The conifer-like tree is located behind the red bush and roughly aligned with the central axis of the courtyard but set back toward the far end of the space.
The rooftop cylindrical tanks sit atop the left-mid building, behind the bridge, forming a cluster visible against the sky.
